svg.text: Silver layer data model: series and its code lookups
SERIES = silver_bls_pr_series | MEASURE = silver_bls_pr_measure | SECTOR = silver_bls_pr_sector
WORKER_CLASS = silver_bls_pr_class | DURATION = silver_bls_pr_duration | SEASONAL = silver_bls_pr_seasonal
Each lookup has one row per code; SERIES holds the code and the lookup supplies the readable text.
